tools.name: content_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze content (file, URL, or text) with any instruction.

Provide exactly one of file_path, url, or text. Uses Gemini's structured
output for reliable JSON responses. Pass a custom output_schema to control
the response shape, or use the default ContentResult schema.

instruction.default: Provide a comprehensive analysis of this content.
instruction.description: What to analyze — e.g. 'summarize key findings', 'extract methodology', 'list all citations'

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the response. If omitted, uses default ContentResult schema.

tools.name: content_batch_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze multiple content files from a directory or explicit file list.

Supports two modes: 'compare' sends all files to Gemini in a single call
for cross-document analysis, 'individual' analyzes each file separately
with bounded concurrency (3 parallel calls).

instruction.default: Provide a comprehensive analysis of these documents.
instruction.description: What to analyze — e.g. 'compare methodologies', 'summarize each document', 'extract key findings'

directory.description: Directory to scan for content files

file_paths.description: Explicit list of file paths to analyze

glob_pattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files within directory

mode.description: 'compare' for cross-document analysis in one call, 'individual' for separate per-file analysis

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for each result

tools.name: content_extract
tools.description:
Extract structured data from content using a JSON Schema.

Uses Gemini's response_json_schema for guaranteed structured output.

schema.description: JSON Schema defining the extraction structure

tools.name: image_crop
tools.description:
Crop local PNG pixels without model inference or provider uploads.

Requires an independently installed FFmpeg and respects LOCAL_FILE_ACCESS_ROOT.
A source hash binds the crop to bytes; it does not establish factual support
or whether the input was synthetic. Large outputs retain metadata/path only.

output_path.description: Fresh local PNG output path; never overwrites

crop_box.description: Integer x, y, width, height in original image pixels

include_image.description: Include a native PNG block up to 1 MiB; false returns identical text metadata

anyOf.description: Exact local pixel operation and hashes, usable by text-only MCP clients.

anyOf.description: Structured error returned from any tool.

tools.name: image_edit

Coordinates use the oriented source grid before crop and resize. Requires

tools.name: research_author_search
tools.description:
Search for academic authors on Semantic Scholar.

Returns author profiles with affiliation, paper count, citation count,
and h-index.

tools.name: research_deep
tools.description:
Run multi-phase deep research with evidence-tier labeling.

Phases: Scope Definition -> Evidence Collection -> Synthesis.
Every claim is labeled CONFIRMED, STRONG INDICATOR, INFERENCE,
SPECULATION, or UNKNOWN.

tools.name: research_document
tools.description:
Run multi-phase deep research grounded in source documents.

Phases: Document Mapping -> Evidence Extraction -> Cross-Reference -> Synthesis.
Every claim is labeled with evidence tiers and cited back to source documents.

instruction.description: Research question or analysis instruction for the documents

urls.description: URLs to PDF documents (downloaded and uploaded to Gemini)

tools.description: Get citations or references for a paper.

tools.name: research_paper_details
tools.description:
Get detailed metadata for a specific paper.

Accepts Semantic Scholar IDs, DOIs (prefix with DOI:), or ArXiv IDs
(prefix with ArXiv:).

paper_id.description: Paper ID: S2 ID, DOI (prefix 'DOI:10.xxx'), or ArXiv (prefix 'ArXiv:2301.xxx')

tools.name: research_paper_recommendations
tools.description:
Get paper recommendations based on seed papers.

Uses Semantic Scholar's recommendation engine to find related papers.

seed_paper_ids.description: List of S2 paper IDs to base recommendations on

tools.name: research_paper_search
tools.description:
Search academic papers on Semantic Scholar.

Returns papers with metadata, abstracts, citation counts, and TL;DR
summaries. Supports filtering by field of study, year range, and
open access availability.

fields_of_study.description: Filter by fields (e.g. Computer Science, Medicine)

year_range.description: Year filter: '2020' for single year, '2020-2024' for range, '2020-' for since

tools.name: research_plan
tools.description:
Generate a multi-agent research orchestration plan.

Returns a phased blueprint with task decomposition and model assignments.
Does NOT spawn agents — provides the blueprint for the caller.

tools.name: research_web
tools.description:
Launch a Gemini Deep Research Agent for autonomous web-grounded research.

The agent plans its own research, searches the web (~80-160 queries),
reads sources, and produces a cited markdown report. Runs in background;
poll with research_web_status. Provider usage is billed; runtime varies.

topic.description: Precise research brief — the more detailed, the better results

output_format.description: Report structure/format instructions (e.g. 'executive summary + data tables')

job_id.description: Resume a recorded launch without resubmitting provider work

tools.name: research_web_cancel
tools.description:
Cancel a running Deep Research task.

Sends a cancel request to the Interactions API and cleans up local
tracking state. Useful for stopping a task before further provider usage.

tools.name: research_web_followup
tools.description:
Ask a follow-up question about a completed Deep Research report.

Uses previous_interaction_id to maintain context from the original
research. Synchronous — follow-ups are fast (no background needed).

interaction_id.description: Completed interaction ID to follow up on

question.description: Follow-up question about the research report

job_id.description: Resume a recorded follow-up without repeating inference

tools.name: research_web_status
tools.description:
Poll or retrieve a Deep Research task.

Returns the full report with sources when completed, or current status
if still in progress. Auto-stores completed reports to Weaviate.

tools.name: video_analyze
tools.description:
Analyze a video (YouTube URL or local file) with any instruction.

Provide exactly one of url or file_path. Uses Gemini's structured output
for reliable JSON responses. Pass a custom output_schema to control the
response shape, or use the default VideoResult schema.

When strict_contract=True, runs the full contract pipeline: analysis with
strict Pydantic models, parallel strategy/concept-map generation, artifact
rendering, and structural quality gates. Factual/media review and observed
coverage remain explicit pending/unknown fields. Returns richer output but takes longer.

anyOf.description: YouTube video URL (youtube.com or youtu.be)

tools.name: vision_ocr
tools.description:
Infer visible text from exact prepared images or precise source frames.

Model transcription is labeled inference. The separate image_ocr operation
selects local Tesseract/Vision observations. No automatic fallback occurs.

request.description: Exact original sources, instruction, selected backend, dry plan and explicit workflow submission grant

items.description: An exact original image, source frame, or bounded video selection.

anyOf.description: Integer pixel xywh or normalized1000 xyxy in the oriented source grid.
An explicit exact target size; the caller chooses its aspect ratio.

limits.description: Still/frame transmission limits without fabricated video windows.

anyOf.description: Observed payload lineage kept distinct from a model's interpretation.
anyOf.title: VisionResponse

anyOf.description: Keep attempted transmissions and storage uncertainty after an unsuccessful call.
anyOf.title: VisionFailure

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web using Gemini's built-in Google Search grounding.

tools.name: youtube_channel_catalog
tools.description:
List one channel uploads page and retain any continuation token.

A channel video count and playlist reported total are provider metadata. The
returned items establish this page's coverage; no video bytes are fetched.

reference.description: YouTube UC channel ID, @handle or canonical channel URL

max_items.description: Maximum upload entries in this API page

page_token.description: Optional next_page_token from a prior response

tools.name: youtube_channel_inspect
tools.description: Inspect channel metadata through YouTube Data API without downloading media.

reference.description: YouTube UC channel ID, @handle or canonical channel URL
